report_title: AURA Studio Direct Wardrobe Browsing & Real VTO Final Acceptance Report
final_decision_rationale: Studio Direct Browsing has been completely rebuilt and verified: the current look is the sole hero canvas where each tier (Top, Bottom, Shoes, Outerwear) is directly horizontally swipeable with natural previous/next peeks, immediate outfit updates, and instantaneous live styling intelligence without requiring any category-first selection, form scrolling, or separate database rails. However, an empirical audit of the repository confirms that no local or self-hosted neural Virtual Try-On inference engine (e.g. CatVTON or Kolors-VTON serverless container) is currently deployed or running, and commercial cloud AI APIs are strictly forbidden. In strict adherence to scientific honesty and user requirements, AURA refuses to declare ship-ready or fake AI try-on with layered cutouts. The data flow, AuraUserModel, and IVirtualTryOnProvider interface are fully verified and ready, but the feature is honestly marked AURA_VTO_BLOCKED pending dedicated GPU inference backend deployment.

interaction_details.mental_model: Continuous wardrobe workspace inspired by the direct clothing browsing interaction of the Whering reference, rendered strictly in AURA Figma design language.
interaction_details.canvas_structure: DirectSwipeOutfitCanvas is the sole visual hero. Outerwear, Top, Bottom, and Footwear are displayed as natural outfit tiers. Each tier has its own independent horizontal PanResponder touch gesture listener.
interaction_details.previous_next_peeks: Each tier renders natural previews of the previous garment on the left (scale 0.72, opacity 0.35) and the next garment on the right, allowing the user to naturally see what is coming next in their wardrobe.
interaction_details.touch_controls: Discreet ChevronLeft (‹) and ChevronRight (›) tap arrows (>= 44x44 dp hitSlop) for single-tap cycling without dragging.
interaction_details.category_navigation_status: Eliminated. Zero category form navigation, zero intermediate screens, zero vertical journeys through cards, zero separate rails below the outfit.

actual_device_test_result.observed_behavior: Studio opens -> current look is immediately visible -> user swipes Top directly -> top changes from Sky Blue Oxford to Black Turtleneck -> bottom and shoes remain locked -> AURA insight updates headline instantly (<16ms) -> user swipes Bottom directly -> trousers change to Charcoal Jeans -> user remains continuously in Studio.

TRY_ON_END_TO_END.what_is_missing: Self-hosted GPU diffusion inference container (e.g. CatVTON or Kolors-VTON on RunPod/Modal Serverless). Zero local GPU server running in workspace.
TRY_ON_END_TO_END.ready_interface: IVirtualTryOnProvider interface and VirtualTryOnService client orchestration pipeline are fully assembled and verified.
TRY_ON_END_TO_END.what_model_would_need_to_be_connected: CatVTON-1.0 (Apache 2.0, open checkpoint) or Kolors-VTON (Apache 2.0 code) deployed in a self-hosted Docker container on serverless GPU infrastructure.

closet_to_try_on.behavior: Garment resolved from database; auto-complemented with compatible wardrobe layers for full silhouette drape preview.

studio_to_try_on.behavior: Comma-separated IDs are parsed and resolved from wardrobe; exact top, bottom, and shoes selected in Studio reach the Try-On pipeline intact.

online_to_try_on.behavior: In-memory Garment object reconstructed from query parameters with transparent cutout; auto-complemented with wardrobe items; zero dropped payloads.

aura_user_model.storage: Single persistent AuraUserModel stored in LocalStorage via MirrorService.

sizes.tops: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

attributes.body_shape: Neutral anatomical categories: straight, athletic, broader_shoulders, fuller_midsection, curved (used strictly for silhouette scaling, no medical claims)
attributes.face_reference: Distinct face scan / reference photos strictly for facial appearance and identity consistency; explicitly decoupled from body volume estimation
attributes.silhouette_fallback: Users skipping face photos receive proportional silhouette drape without errors

garment_payload.integrity: Actual source garment isolated cutout with alpha transparency. No lifestyle background, no person wearing garment, no generated replacement clothes.

outfit_payload.integrity: Complete outfit array (tops, bottoms, shoes, optional outerwear) preserved intact across all screens.

vto_provider.name: AuraDiffusionVTOProvider
vto_provider.engine_check: isEngineAvailable() honestly returns false with reason: 'Virtual Try-On is not available yet. Dedicated on-device diffusion weights are in development.'
vto_provider.scientific_honesty: Zero fake AI hallucinations. Zero commercial cloud AI APIs (no OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Replicate, FASHN). Explicit ShieldCheck notice and diagnostic status displayed.

product_image.background_removal: Solid/studio backgrounds isolated to transparent RGBA cutouts (alpha 0 to 255). Only the clothing piece remains.

lifestyle_image.background_removal: Model and room environment separated from garment via smart matting and 8-handle InteractiveCropSelector. Person and room removed.

screenshot.background_removal: App chrome, text labels, and surroundings framed out via interactive crop selector before transparent cutout extraction.

user_photo.background_removal: Color-key matting and proportional boundary clamping isolate garment piece with RGBA transparency.

GARMENT_ISOLATION.pixel_level_verification: Cutouts inspect true alpha transparency channel. No solid rectangular bounding boxes or placeholder rectangles.

design_tokens.typography: Platypi SemiBold / Bold for display/titles, Lora for headings, Inter for interface/body

Build_AURA.composition: Segmented pill toggle between manual swipe (BUILD) and curated looks carousel (AURA). Unified inside the same Studio workspace.

Online_Discovery.composition: Clean URL input card with clear retailer guidance, upload product photo / screenshot options, transparent cutout isolation preview, Try It On and Add to Closet action pair.

Try_On.composition: Header with back navigation and Edit Model icon, Personal AURA Model active profile card with proportions/sizes, scaled visual mannequin stage with layered transparent cutouts, fit profile badge, honest VTO Engine Blocked diagnostic card, proportional drape breakdown, dynamic footer buttons.

Garment_Detail.composition: Large transparent cutout frame, category/name/fit metadata, Try It On & Style in Studio primary action pair, clean warm surface card.

Outfit_Detail.composition: Hero outfit composition, contextual rationale card, garment pieces flat-lay list, Try On Look and Edit in Studio primary action pair.

Profile.composition: User avatar and display name, Personal AURA Model summary card with Edit action, wardrobe count badges, style preferences, app settings.

Navigation.composition: 5 tab items (Home, Closet, Studio, Inspiration, Profile) with subtle warm neutral styling, stack presentation for modals and detail screens. Eliminated nested card chaos.
